# Long Island Endodontics

> Board-certified endodontic specialists in Woodmere, NY offering advanced root canal treatment, microsurgery, and comprehensive tooth-saving solutions with 3D imaging technology.

Long Island Endodontics is a dental practice specializing in endodontic care, led by four board-certified endodontists (Drs. Berry, Rosen, Goodman, and Zhao). The practice serves patients across Long Island with advanced treatments including root canal therapy, apicoectomy, apexification, and internal bleaching, supported by modern 3D cone beam radiography and flexible financing options.

## Core Services & Treatments

- [Long Island Endodontics - Home](https://www.liendodontics.com): Board-certified endodontic specialists offering root canal care and advanced tooth-saving treatments in Woodmere, NY
- [Services](https://www.liendodontics.com/services): Advanced endodontic services with 3D imaging and micro-endodontics
- [Root Canal Therapy](https://www.liendodontics.com/treatments/root-canal-therapy-woodmere-new-york): Root canal therapy to relieve pain and save infected teeth
- [Apicoectomy](https://www.liendodontics.com/treatments/apicoectomy-woodmere-new-york): Microsurgical apicoectomy to remove root tip infection
- [Root Canal Retreatment](https://www.liendodontics.com/treatments/root-canal-retreatment-woodmere-new-york): Expert retreatment to fix failed root canals and eliminate infection
- [Apexification](https://www.liendodontics.com/treatments/apexification-woodmere-new-york): Apexification treatment for immature teeth using biocompatible materials
- [Internal Bleaching](https://www.liendodontics.com/treatments/internal-bleaching-woodmere-new-york): Internal bleaching to whiten discolored root canal-treated teeth
- [Root Resorption Treatment](https://www.liendodontics.com/treatments/root-resorption-woodmere-new-york): Early diagnosis and treatment of root resorption to preserve teeth
- [All Treatments](https://www.liendodontics.com/treatments): Comprehensive treatment options: apicoectomy, bleaching, apexification
